text: Find a place where you can be still for a few minutes...
Notice where your body meets the surface beneath you.
See if you can notice your heartbeat.
Maybe you hear it close to your ear. Maybe you feel it somewhere in your body.
If you can't find it, stay with your breath.
Take a moment and notice your breathing.
You don't have to change it.
Let the rhythm be whatever it is.
You might take a few comfortable breaths.
Notice what happens, without asking anything to change.
Let the music hold this quiet for a while.
For now, there’s nothing more you need to do.
